newsitem.title: USA: Benguet to suspend Dizon mines operation.
newsitem.headline: Benguet to suspend Dizon mines operation.

text.p: Benguet Corp said Wednesday it would suspend operations at its Dizon Copper-Gold mines starting August 1 because of damage caused by a typhoon in the last week of May.
The Manila-based company said that a special meeting of the its board on June 24, it considered several options on the Dizon mine operations.
It said that if it decides to rehabilitate the Dizon pit, it would require additional capital funds of 241 million pesos to put it back into operation.
In that event, it said the mine would be suspended for 10 months beginning in August, with resumption of operations expected in June 1998.
The company said a full evaluation of its options and a report will be submitted to the board for a final decision on a course of action.
